goal: Design a repeatable Career OS system-level eval-set architecture from confirmed pass/fail operating cases, separating end-to-end terminal-state correctness from step-level diagnostics, without implementing evaluators or Phase F trace/contract architecture.
acceptance_conditions: Report defines a repeatable eval-set architecture grounded only in confirmed durable evidence; no invented traces, fixtures, pass/fail outcomes, or incidence claims.
Report separates end-to-end terminal-state correctness from step-level diagnostics and explains that a system case can fail terminally even when some step diagnostics pass.

Every proposed case row records provenance quality, operating case identity, expected terminal outcome, diagnostic layer, evaluator type/owner, current executability, and blocking evidence gaps where applicable.

Cases with missing raw traces or missing package artifacts are not falsely presented as executable end-to-end fixtures; they are explicitly classified as reconstruction-backed design cases or blocked candidates.
Objective lexical/structural/identity/state-transition rules remain deterministic-first; no LLM judge is specified for enumerable banned/internal vocabulary or other objective facts.
Any potential calibrated LLM-judge role is limited to genuinely subjective residual style/naturalness/fidelity after objective checks and human calibration, and remains future/non-implemented.

The architecture includes representative negative and positive operating cases where source material is sufficient, including live-actionability/dead-route, recency suppression, application lifecycle/duplicate continuity, controller/provider integrity, package-quality/gold-family, and clean successful/handoff cases.
The report distinguishes CI regression evals from live production monitoring/incidence and makes no production failure-rate claim.

No CAREER_OS_RUN_TRACE_V1 schema, trace contract, typed envelope, trace infrastructure, database/UI, orchestration automation, new agent, model routing, LLM-judge implementation, or product/runtime behavior is designed or implemented.
Phase E completes as COMPLETED_BY_OPERATOR / PENDING_BORA_ACCEPTANCE / READ_ONLY_DESIGN_ONLY with implementation_authorized=false; Phase F and all later phases remain PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
Cursor independent adversarial review is required on the frozen exact diff before commit/push/PR; Cursor may not repair its own findings.
stop_conditions: Stop if substantive Phase F trace/contract architecture would be required to complete the report.
Stop if a proposed eval case requires inventing unavailable raw evidence or reconstructing facts beyond durable records.
Stop if any implementation or runtime mutation would be required.
Stop at Bora human acceptance gate after a reviewed/merged Phase E completion transition; do not authorize Phase F implicitly.
